items.title: No agenda, no rush, no leaving San Francisco: Benchmark’s partners on investing in a frenzied market
items.summary: Benchmark may have grown its funds and swapped out some partners, but onstage the five who are left sounded like friends who just happen to be running one of the Valley’s most storied firms
items.creator: Connie Loizos
